verses.text: The proverbs of Solomon, David's son and king of Israel.
They're here so you can learn wisdom and instruction and recognize words that give insight.
They teach you how to act wisely and do what's right, just, and fair.
They give good judgment to the inexperienced, and knowledge and discretion to young people.
Let wise people listen and learn even more. Let people with understanding get sound advice.
Learn to understand proverbs and parables, the sayings and riddles of the wise.
Reverence for the LORD is where knowledge begins. Fools look down on wisdom and instruction.
My son, listen to what your father teaches you. Don't walk away from your mother's instruction.
Their teaching is like a crown of flowers on your head and a chain of honor around your neck.
My son, if people pull you toward sin, don't go along.
They might say, “Come with us. Let's wait in hiding to spill blood. Let's ambush innocent people for no reason.
Let's swallow them alive like Sheol, whole like people going down to the pit.
We'll get all kinds of valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
Join our crew. We'll all share the same purse.”
My son, don't go down that road with them. Keep your feet off their path.
Their feet run toward evil. They're in a hurry to spill blood.
There's no point spreading a net where a bird can see it.
But these people are setting an ambush for themselves. They're putting their own lives in the trap.
That's where greed for profit leads. It takes the lives of the people who chase it.
Wisdom calls out in the street. She raises her voice in the public squares.
She calls out over the noise. At the entrance to the city gates, here's what she says:
“How long will you who lack judgment be happy to stay that way? How long will mockers love mocking and fools hate knowledge?
Turn around when I correct you. Look, I'll pour out my spirit on you and make my words known to you.
I called, and you refused to listen. I reached out my hand, and nobody paid attention.
You brushed off all my advice and wanted nothing to do with my correction.
So I'll laugh when disaster hits you. I'll mock when trouble catches up with you,
when calamity sweeps in like a storm and disaster hits like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish close in.
Then they'll call out to me, but I won't answer. They'll look hard for me, but they won't find me,
because they hated knowledge and never chose to revere the LORD.
They wanted nothing to do with my advice and despised every correction I gave.
So they'll eat the fruit of their choices and get their fill of their own schemes.
The inexperienced will die because they turned away, and fools will be destroyed by their own carelessness.
But whoever listens to me will live safely and be at ease, without fear of harm.”
